main.description: A record indicating that a expression belongs to a corpus, with optional split assignment.

corpusRef.description: AT-URI of the corpus this expression belongs to.

expressionRef.description: AT-URI of the expression that is a member of the corpus.

splitUri.description: AT-URI of the split definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

metadata.description: Provenance: who assigned this expression to this corpus, when, with what tool.

features.description: Open-ended features for this membership (e.g., source file, import batch, quality flags).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this membership record was created.
